Umbrella disorder of glycine metabolism; additional organ damage is not established across the group.
Vitreoretinal dystrophy with night blindness, retinal degeneration, retinoschisis and impaired visual acuity.
Inherited intestinal disaccharidase deficiency causing defective carbohydrate digestion and absorption.

Recurrent upper airway obstruction during sleep; cardiovascular consequences are risks or separately diagnosed diseases.
Progressive CNS demyelination and autonomic dysfunction. Neurogenic bladder reflects neurologic disease; direct urinary tract damage is not established.

Defined by upper limb skeletal malformations and cardiac arrhythmias, both reported in 80-99%; intellectual disability and dental abnormalities are occasional.
Congenital absence of the duodenal lumen; associated vascular anomalies and electrolyte disturbances occur in fewer than 30%.
Metabolic defect with spastic diplegia, intellectual disability and retinitis pigmentosa in 3/4 reported family members; causal link to biochemical defect remains uncertain.
Spondylometaphyseal skeletal dysplasia affecting vertebrae and metaphyses; no evidence for another organ axis.

Typically cutaneous non-Langerhans histiocytic proliferation; histiocytic lineage supports haematologic classification. Extracutaneous involvement is uncommon.
Congenital coronary sinus atrial septal defect; associated anomalous vessels remain cardiovascular. Dyspnea alone does not establish pulmonary damage.

Neurodegenerative developmental disorder; persistent strabismus in 80-99%, scoliosis and clubfoot in 30-79%. Constipation and feeding difficulty alone do not establish GI damage.
Structural enlargement of the tongue, an oral organ. Endocrine disorders are possible causes rather than intrinsic involvement.

Lymphoid malignancy occupying chest wall structures, usually diffuse large B-cell lymphoma; chest wall involvement does not itself establish lung disease.
Obstetric disorder of fetal vessels traversing membranes near the cervical opening; no intrinsic disease of an organ within the 13 axes.
Inherited citrulline transport abnormality with metabolic/homeostatic disturbance; supplied evidence does not establish direct damage to another organ.
